title: Deterministic latest order
instructions: Return the latest order for each customer with any orders. All statuses and years participate. Order timestamps descending, then order identities descending.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,customer_id,ordered_at from orders without solving deterministic latest order.

hints.text: ROW_NUMBER selects one winner per customer using a total order.
Rank all orders inside each customer partition, then retain row number one.
Orders 10001 and 10002 tie in time. Do not filter to paid orders or UTC 2024.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT count(*)::VARCHAR FROM orders WHERE order_id IN (10001, 10002) AND ordered_at = TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-06-15 10:00:00+00'
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: orders 10001 and 10002 tie in time
